outcome: Maternally derived SARS-CoV-2 anti-spike (anti-S) IgG in pregnant participants and infants
Neutralizing antibodies (neutAb) in pregnant participants and infants
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 107 pregnant participants with prior SARS-CoV-2 infection and their infants.
finding: In pregnant individuals with prior SARS-CoV-2, vaccination before delivery provided more durable maternally derived antibody responses in infants through 6 months compared to infection alone.
